articles.summary: Barrons.com: We Could Witness the End of Cheap Cars. Here’s How It Could Happen.. FEATURE The end of cheap cars is looming over the American buyer. It’s just one more thing to worry about. Wait? There were cheap cars? To be sure, cars are way more expensive than they used to be. The average price of a new car is up roughly $10,000 since the Covid-19 pandemic. Related tickers mentioned: 000270.KS, 7201.T, GM, ^GSPC.

articles.summary: Business Wire: Ford Motor Company Board Declares Dividend for Second-Quarter 2026. DEARBORN, Mich., April 28, 2026--The board of directors of Ford Motor Company today declared a second-quarter regular dividend of 15 cents per share on the company’s outstanding common and Class B stock.
